'''Lux''' was a modified [[Seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who was used for security in the [[Glow Dome]] a nightclub located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. He was heavily armed and modified by Dr. [[Lytos Urtell]].

==Biography==
Lux was purchased used by [[Glow Dome]] co-owner [[Corinna A'Daasha]] and heavily modified by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lytos Urtell]]. The droid was originally programmed hunt and track criminals but Urtell added programming and armaments turned the droid into a potent security guard.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
The droid retained its law enforcement programming to find and detect criminals. Although the droid was a tiny sphere it had been programmed to talk like a grizzled cop, a veteran of the streets. Lux did not tolerate any back-talk. Lux did not trust Doctor Urtell and told this to Corinna repeatedly.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a Seeker droid, Lux had powerful sensors and programming that allowed gave him the ability to track individuals down to a genetic level and analyze individuals for potential threats. His ability to identify criminals made Dr. Urtell nervous as he was conducting several illegal operations at the time. Doctor Urtell tried to get Lux in for a maintenance overhaul but the droid correctly determined that the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] doctor was a potential threat.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
Armed with a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Model MSD-32 Disruptor Pistol]] and a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Persuader heavy stun gun]], Lux was a floating armory that could enforce security by extremely deadly force.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lux was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Tom O'Neill]].
